text: Rework the role prompts so a request's real goal survives to the verdict; job 20261014-154909-f4bt shows how it is lost. Its reader turned 'useful to someone who has never seen firstmate' into presence checks (a section exists, a glossary exists), never looked at the page, and put the real gaps out of scope; the producer is told to change only what the criteria need; the verifier saw that the page never says what firstmate is but filed it minor because the criteria passed, and request_reading_mismatch is not used in any verdict. Change it so: the reader names the audience and writes at least one criterion as an outcome that audience can check, never puts the request's own goal out of scope, and reads the current output before planning a change to it; the producer treats criteria as a floor and serves the request; a request-reading mismatch from the verifier counts as major in code; the verifier judges user-facing output as its audience would. The reader's fixed prompt is at 1,798 of 1,800 tokens; raise that budget as far as these rules need, and record why.
